fact: A mission of 9-27 August 2021 found that lack of official national ID blocks mobile money accounts, and UNHCR arranged with Ecobank that its Voluntary Repatriation Form serve as ID for cash payments, without yet exploring digital payments.
title: Republique Centrafricaine Evaluation de l'Ecosysteme des Paiements Numeriques pour les Programmes de Transferts Monetaires des Filets de Protection Sociale
